title: Demystifying Oversmoothing in Sheaf Neural Networks: An Index-Theoretic Criterion
abstract: arXiv:2608.16180v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To combat oversmoothing in Graph Convolutional Networks, Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) were proposed as a generalization by equipping the graph with a sheaf structure and replacing the graph Laplacian with a sheaf Laplacian $\mathcal{L}$. Existing analyses connect sheaf diffusion to oversmoothing via the harmonic space ($\ker\mathcal{L}$), taking its absolute dimension as an indicator of anti-oversmoothing capacity. However, absolute dimension alone is not a reliable measure: certain sheaf configurations inflate $\dim \ker \mathcal{L}$ while their harmonic sections remain entirely constant, without enriching discriminative capacity. We instead introduce the first relative, geometric approach, yielding a precise characterisation of anti-oversmoothing capacity. translated_title: 揭示Sheaf神经网络中的过度平滑问题：一种指标理论判据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16180v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：为了对抗图卷积网络中的过度平滑问题，Sheaf神经网络（SNNs）被提出作为一种泛化方法，通过为图配备一个sheaf结构，并将图拉普拉斯算子替换为sheaf拉普拉斯算子$\mathcal{L}$。现有分析通过调和空间（$\ker\mathcal{L}$）将sheaf扩散与过度平滑联系起来，将其绝对维度作为抗过度平滑能力的指标。然而，绝对维度本身并非可靠度量：某些sheaf配置会增大$\dim \ker \mathcal{L}$，但其调和截面完全保持恒定，并未增强判别能力。我们反而引入了首个相对的、几何的方法，从而对抗过度平滑能力给出精确刻画。在茎传输和全局sheaf结构的自然条件下，我们建立了一个指标理论比较判据，表明一个sheaf的调和空间真正地...
tldr: 本文提出首个基于指标理论的几何判据，精确刻画Sheaf神经网络的抗过度平滑能力，克服了绝对维度指标的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first index-theoretic geometric criterion to precisely characterize anti-oversmoothing capacity in Sheaf Neural Networks, overcoming the limitation of absolute dimension metrics.
